question: In May 2023, which Chief Minister was honoured with the Bharat Ratna Dr. Ambedkar award for creating a fear-free state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yogi Adityanath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, was honored with the Bharat Ratna Dr. Ambedkar Award in May 2023.
 
• The award was given in recognition of his efforts to create a **fear-free state** through effective governance and law enforcement.
 
• Yogi Adityanath's administration has focused on **enhancing law and order**, reducing crime rates, and ensuring public safety in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• His government introduced several initiatives aimed at the **empowerment of women** and marginalized communities, contributing to societal upliftment.
 
• The Bharat Ratna Dr. Ambedkar Award is a prestigious recognition for contributions toward **social justice**, governance, and the principles advocated by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**

 
 
• Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar was a renowned jurist, economist, social reformer, and the **architect of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• He championed the cause of **social justice, equality, and the upliftment of marginalized communities** in India.
 
• Ambedkar's principles continue to inspire awards and initiatives promoting governance aligned with his vision.
 
 
 
• **Law and Order in Uttar Pradesh**
 
 
• Under Yogi Adityanath's leadership, Uttar Pradesh witnessed **improved law enforcement** measures, reducing organized crime and enhancing public safety.
 
• Initiatives like the **Anti-Romeo Squad** targeted crimes against women, ensuring their safety in public spaces.
 
• Technological reforms, such as **e-FIRs and digitization of police records**, have improved transparency and efficiency in governance.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Ratna Dr. Ambedkar Award**
 
 
• This award honors individuals or organizations that contribute significantly to **social justice and governance**, reflecting Dr. Ambedkar's principles.
 
• Recipients are recognized for their work in improving societal conditions and implementing inclusive governance models.
 
 
 
• **Governance Principles of Yogi Adityanath**
 
 
• Yogi Adityanath's governance emphasizes **transparency, accountability, and public service delivery**.
 
• His administration focuses on **infrastructure development, healthcare, and education reforms** to benefit citizens.
 
• Efforts to empower marginalized communities and ensure public safety have been central to his leadership.
